LanguageData.VGE_AsteroidCluster.description: A cluster of asteroid fragments orbiting in close formation. It may be the remains of a larger body or several smaller rocks captured by the same gravity well.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_AsteroidField.description: A dense field of small asteroids and rock fragments drifting in a loose orbit. The debris is too scattered for a major mining operation but poses a serious navigation hazard.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_AsteroidWithRuins.description: An asteroid with the shattered remains of a pre-War orbital station clinging to its surface. Twisted beams and broken modules have collapsed into the rock.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_CoreAsteroidMiningSite.description: An asteroid with an unusually dense core of valuable minerals. Its lower orbit makes it a rare mining opportunity, although the compacted rock will be slow to excavate. No signs of life are visible.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_DenseAsteroid.description: An unusually dense asteroid with very little safe surface for landing or construction.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_DerelictStation.description: A derelict pre-War orbital station, long abandoned and stripped of most valuables. Only its skeletal frame drifts silently through space.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_GiantAsteroid.description: A massive asteroid that dominates the surrounding orbital sector and offers ample room for landing and excavation.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipGenerationSite.label: Hellion generation site
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipGenerationSite.description: A temporary technical site used to generate Hellion flight-map textures.
LanguageData.VGE_IceAsteroid.description: An ice asteroid captured and moved into orbit during a pre-War USSA resource project. Thick frozen layers give it a pale, reflective surface unlike ordinary rock.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_PorousAsteroid.description: An asteroid riddled with cavities and unstable tunnels formed by impacts and erosion. Its honeycombed structure is fragile and prone to collapse.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_ShatteredAsteroid.label: shattered asteroid
LanguageData.VGE_ShatteredAsteroid.description: An asteroid broken apart by a massive impact. Its jagged fragments remain loosely bound with wide gaps between them.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_SmallAsteroid.description: A small asteroid drifting through orbit. Bodies of this size are unstable and may eventually fall as meteors.\n\nThis location can be reached using cargo pods, vertibirds, or the Hellion.
